title: The Flying House of Loreto
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of The Flying House of Loreto, about 1200-1800 at Loreto, Italy, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they would see things they thought were flying houses okay the Flying House of Laredo

plain: A researcher, Diana Pasulka, tells the old story of the Flying House of Loreto, from the town of Loreto in Italy. She says people in earlier centuries saw things in the sky that they thought were flying houses, and she offers this one as an example. She raises it on Jesse Michels's podcast to suggest that what we now call UFOs may have been described in religious terms long ago.
